facts.fact: Neela tells the hall that the twenty-nine of the forty who have self-named are free of Chathu entirely, since naming voided every other witness. Only the eleven who have not chosen still answer to his mouth, which is now the high court's. He can write only those eleven, and only if someone hands him resin.
Neela states the Thurai on the beach as twelve hundred or more, after the officer losses (revises the fourteen hundred of F795).
